description:
What changed between two Site Audit crawls of a site: Site Health and theme deltas, new and fixed issues per check, pages added, removed or changed status, and robots.txt rule changes.

Billing: free — compares stored crawls; nothing is fetched.

When to call: after a re-crawl, to show what was fixed and what broke; then get_crawl_issue with compare "new" or "fixed" for the URLs.

Default: the latest scored crawl vs the one before with the same check version (a different settings scope gives scope_changed: true, no pages added/removed). Different check versions compare totals only (mode "summary": new/fixed null).

Returns: { site_id, run: { run_id, started_at, site_health }, base (null: first scored crawl), comparison: { mode, health: { from, to, delta }, themes, totals: { new_errors, fixed_errors, new_items, fixed_items }, checks: [{ id, severity, from, to, new, fixed }] (changed only, biggest first), pages: { added, removed, status_changed, became_broken, became_noindex, became_indexable, samples } | null, robots: { changed, added_rules, removed_rules } } | null, history (≤12), suggested_next?, next_step }.

base_run_id.description: Optional run to compare with. Default: the crawl before run_id.

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

run_id.description: Optional run id (history[].run_id). Default: the latest scored crawl.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

name: compare_crawls
title: Compare two crawls of a site: new and fixed issues, Site Health change
